events.time: 7:00 PM · Portage Evangelical Church, 72 3 St NE, Portage la prairie, MB
events.description: A Night of Worship: The Songs of Robin Mark Join us for a special evening of worship as we celebrate the powerful music and ministry of Robin Mark, one of the most influential worship songwriters of our time. Best known for writing worship anthems such as "Days of Elijah," "Jesus, All for Jesus," "Revival," "The Wonder of the Cross," "When It's All Been Said and Done" and "Not by Might," Robin Mark's songs have inspired believers around the world to draw closer to God through heartfelt praise and worship. This uplifting night will feature many of Robin Mark's most loved songs, giving us the opportunity to sing together, reflect on God's faithfulness, and celebrate the hope we have in Christ. Whether these songs have been part of your worship journey for years or you are hearing them for the first time, this evening promises to be a meaningful time of praise, encouragement, and community. Come ready to lift your voice, worship with friends and family, and experience the joy of gathering around songs that have impacted churches across the globe. Together we'll revisit timeless favorites, share in God's presence, and proclaim His goodness through song. "These are the days of Elijah, declaring the Word of the Lord." All are welcome. Bring a friend and join us for an unforgettable evening of worship through the songs of Robin Mark. This special worship night is also a fundraiser in support of the 2027 Fun With Family Day Festival, whose theme is"Victory Over Darkness." Through worship, community, and outreach, the festival seeks to share the hope, light, and transforming love of Jesus Christ with individuals and families throughout our region. As we sing these powerful songs of faith, revival, and God's faithfulness, we are reminded that Christ has overcome the darkness of sin, fear, and despair. Every donation and act of support helps create opportunities to proclaim that message of hope beyond the walls of the church and into our community. Together, we can help create an event where families encounter encouragement, connection, and the life-changing truth that"the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it." By supporting this fundraiser, you are investing in a ministry that seeks to point people to the ultimate victory found in Jesus Christ.

events.title: Another Night of Country Music
events.time: 7:30 PM · Manitou Opera House, 325 Main Street, Manitou, MB
events.description: After packing the house with a sold-out performance in November 2025, The Sharpe Brothers Band is making a highly anticipated return to the Manitou Opera House this November - this time for two performances of Another Night of Country Music. And before anyone asks - no, they're not all brothers. The Sharpe Brothers Band features brothers Will Sharpe (vocals/guitar) and James Sharpe (vocals/bass), along with Charlie Howatt (steel guitar), Gil Dudgeon (drums), and Larry Martineau (fiddle/harmonica). A performance at the Manitou Opera House with The Sharpe Brothers Band offers a timeless country music experience reminiscent of the Grand Ole Opry, right here in southern Manitoba. Audiences can expect a show filled with traditional country music, honky-tonk favourites, outstanding musicianship, a few surprises, and the warm, intimate atmosphere that has made the historic Manitou Opera House one of southern Manitoba's premier live music venues. Their 2025 appearance at the Manitou Opera House sold out well in advance, leaving many hoping for another opportunity to experience the band live. In response to the demand, the Manitou Opera House Foundation is thrilled to welcome them back for not one, but two unforgettable showings of country music, offering audiences the opportunity to attend either - or both - shows. With last year's performance selling out, early ticket purchases are strongly encouraged. Thank you to our event sponsors: Manitou Thrift Store, Dead Horse Cider Co., and Blumstein Brewing Co. Cash bar selling beverages and snacks will be open at before the show and at intermission.

events.description: Webinar: Healthy Frogs, Healthy Prairies: Disease Research in Sentinel Aspen Parkland–Grassland Species Tuesday November 17th at 12:00pm MT Speaker: Jackie Tran, Brandon University Register Free: https://shorturl.at/Wzf2U About this Presentation: Presentation description: What can our frogs, toads, and salamanders tell us about the health of our prairies? As important sentinel species, amphibians can provide valuable clues about the condition of our wetlands and surrounding landscapes. Our research explores emerging fungal diseases in Manitoba amphibians, examining how wetland habitats, environmental conditions, physiological stress, and genetic immunity influence their vulnerability to infection. We also investigate how these diseases may spread across landscapes over time. This presentation will highlight the connections between healthy amphibians, healthy wetlands, and the important role of the landowners and the public in supporting resilient ecosystems. This webinar is part of SK PCAP’s Native Prairie Speaker Series. As always, this webinar is FREE and everyone is welcome to attend! Whether you arrive in a gown, a blazer, or your favourite evening outfit, you’ll be right at home.
